title: All day: Late Asia 00:00-02:00 - reclaim (long-view pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: start trading 24/7 - which setups work in each part of the NQ day, at the same or a higher win rate than LIT?
notes: tools/allday.py, variant reclaim|late_asia|sofar,0.0,3,cisd|S,None,w; picked: long-view pick (2021-24, plateau score)

rules: Window: Late Asia 00:00-02:00 (entry bar inside it).
Level: the trading day's high / low so far (from 18:00).
Sweep: a 5m bar trades through the level.
Reclaim: within 3 bars a 5m close back inside that is also beyond the open of the candle run into the extreme (CISD).
Short after a high sweep, long after a low sweep; stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme; the setup's own level = the box's other side.
Target the setup's own level (see above; >= 1R away, banked at 8R).
Time exit: flat at the window end + 60 min. One trade a day. Entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop and time exits - 1 tick; $1.40 a micro.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.
